The Mortgage Loan documents limit losses and damages to those actually  incurred.  The related non-recourse carveout guarantor is liable solely with respect  to its interest in its Series B assets. The related guarantor is a Delaware Series LLC and its operating agreement creates three separate  series of assets (A, B, and AB). The related Mortgaged Property is a Series B asset.
